name: Imanje Tycoon
description: Pokrećeš imanje od nule: pečurke, plastenik i ribnjak. Macro planiranje × Micro izvedba × permakulturna ekonomika — dostigni Fazu C kroz 4-6 sati sa realnim guncatskim brojkama.

modules.index.html: Ulazna tačka — 4 CSS importa, app-root DOM sa #macro-panel + #tabs-nav + #tab-content, ES6 module entry
modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap: init state, bind tabs, start idle ticker, sync HUD, pokretanje audio konteksta na prvi klik
modules.src/config.js: Sve GAME_CONFIG konstante iz GDD-a — cene, brzerine rasta, faza uslovi, upgrade troškovi, kanal multiplijer, prestiž parametri
modules.src/state.js: Kompletna state struktura: kapital, faza, sezona, sve tri grane, kanali, radnici, reputation, achievements; save/load localStorage + JSON export/import
modules.src/engine/tick.js: Idle ticker: requestAnimationFrame loop, deltaTime, offline progress na load (max 8h cap), per-grana yield accumulation, season timer countdown
modules.src/economy/mushrooms.js: Pečurke ekonomija: blok životni ciklus (3 talasa po bloku), spawn_ratio kalkulacija, inokulacija timer (10s prozor, on-time bonus), prinos per tick, oyster/bukovača razlika
modules.src/economy/greenhouse.js: Plastenik ekonomija: paradajz/mikrobiljke ciklusi, yield per m2 per tick, harvest prozor (8s), grace period (4h real → proporcionalan game tick), suša penalty logika
modules.src/economy/fishpond.js: Jezero ekonomija: logistička rast kriva za šarana/smuđa, hranjenje event (60s ciklus, 15s prozor, +5% rast bonus), patke jaja (dnevni prihod), harvest logika
modules.src/economy/market.js: Market engine: channel_multiplier primena, capacity cap enforcement, overflow na direktnu prodaju, revenue kalkulacija po granu, tržišni radar (2-sezonski forecast)
modules.src/economy/synergies.js: Sinergije: Komposter (patke+pečurke, +25% spawn_ratio), Mulj đubrivo (J5 → plastenik +30% yield), Ekosistem Masterclass (Faza C, +5% sve grane per masterclass), boolean flags u state
modules.src/systems/upgrades.js: Svih 24 upgradova (8 Pečurke + 8 Plastenik + 8 Jezero): canPurchase (kapital + faza check), purchase, apply efekt na state, prikaz u UI
modules.src/systems/phases.js: Faza tracker (0→A→B→C): evaluatePhase() posle svakog revenue update-a, unlock logika, phase transition toast
modules.src/systems/seasons.js: Season sistem: countdown timer (120s→90s od S5+), season transition handler, slučajni eventi (8% od S3+: suša/bolest/zaraza/rekordna/inspekcija), season history log
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Prestige: eligibility check (Faza C + 3 uzastopne sezone ≥150k), prestige modal (3 scenarija: Guncati/Avala/Štrand), reset sa 50% kapital carry, yield multiplier, alumni bonus, speed multiplier
modules.src/systems/achievements.js: Svih 25 achievements: trigger check posle relevantnih state promena, unlock (toast + permanent bonus primena), localStorage tracking
modules.src/systems/workers.js: Daily action sistem: base_actions=5, +3 po radniku, akcije troše iz daily_budget, reset na season change, unlock hired workers u Fazi A/B/C
modules.src/systems/masterclass.js: Masterclass eventi: unlock u S4+, organizacija troši daily_budget, ++masterclass_count, reputation_bonus update, alumni_network_bonus calc, Ekosistem sinergija check
modules.src/ui/tabs.js: Tab navigacija: #tabs-nav dugmad (Makro | Pečurke | Plastenik | Jezero), tab switching, active tab state, keyboard shortcut (1-4)
modules.src/ui/macro-panel.js: Macro panel (uvek vidljiv top): kapital display, season timer, faza badge, daily actions preostalo, channel mix, investicija dugmad za grane unlock, Masterclass trigger
modules.src/ui/mushroom-tab.js: Pečurke tab: blok grid (5 max), per-blok progress bar (inkubacija), talas counter (1/3), inokulacija button + countdown, prihod/dan display, harvest kapacitet widget
modules.src/ui/greenhouse-tab.js: Plastenik tab: crop display (paradajz/mikrobiljke), area bar (current/max m2), harvest countdown + grace indicator, sezona prihod projekcija, suša warning
modules.src/ui/fishpond-tab.js: Jezero tab: riba rast progress, tip (šaran/smuđ), hranjenje button + timer, patke display (jaja/dan), harvest button (samo na 100%)
modules.src/ui/upgrades-panel.js: Upgrade shop panel (side panel u svakom tabu): filtrovana lista upgradova po granu, locked/unlocked/purchased state, cijena, ProjectionModal trigger na >5000 din
modules.src/ui/projection.js: Pre-invest projection modal: investicija detalji, procenjeni prihod/sezona, breakeven, ROI@3 sezone, kapacitet ceiling — Confirm/Cancel
modules.src/ui/synergy-tree.js: Sinergija tech tree: 3 čvora (Komposter/Mulj/Ekosistem), locked ali vidljivi od Faze 0, req lista, aktivan/neaktivan status, hover tooltip
modules.src/ui/hud.js: Persistent HUD (top bar): kapital + trend, faza indicator, season # + countdown, daily actions (X/Y), reputation star
modules.src/ui/modals.js: Modal sistem: achievement toast (bottom-right, 3s, edukativna poruka), season end summary, prestige modal (3 scenarija kartice), random event overlay, phase unlock fanfare
modules.src/ui/channel-panel.js: Prodajni kanal UI: channel list sa % slider-ima, kanal lock status, kapacitet indicator (X/Y kg/mesec), ukupni prihod projekcija
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: folk-inspired ambient (srpska lestvica, 70BPM, sintetički pad + pizzicato + breathe-noise), SFX (harvest/inokulacija/achievement/season/prestige), masterGain, mute toggle
modules.src/share.js: Share: Canvas.toDataURL() ili static achievement card, Web Share API payload ('Imanje Tycoon: X din/mesec @Guncati'), fallback clipboard copy
modules.styles/base.css: Layout: CSS varijable Guncati paleta, app-root grid (macro-panel top + main content), responsive mobile-first, Guncati font stack, loading screen
modules.styles/ui.css: Dashboard UI: tab nav, panel cards, upgrade items (locked/unlocked/purchased), channel sliders, progress bars, prestige modal, projection modal, HUD bar
modules.styles/game.css: Animacije: achievement toast slide-in/out, phase unlock pulse, season transition fade, blok inkubacija shimmer, riba rast pulse, sinergija glow efekt
modules.styles/theme.css: Guncati brand paleta: CSS vars (#6B4C2A zemlja, #4A7C3F zelena, #3A7BD5 voda, #A8D5A2 plastenik, #E8D5F0 pečurke, #D4A017 kapital, #E07B39 event akcent)
